description:
A single control cycle in a rollout trace.

One clock: MuJoCo simulation time `data.time`, in seconds. Non-finite values are
written as the strings "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity" so the line stays JSON; a
check that needs such a value says CHƯA RÕ instead of scoring it.

run_plan_id.description: RunPlan of the run; a run without one (G0, scripted eval) uses g0-<story>-<yyyymmdd>, for example g0-DA-38-20261103.
run_plan_id.title: Run Plan Id

t_state.description: Simulation time the state was read, s.
t_state.title: T State

t_image.description: Simulation time of the frame fed to the policy in this cycle, s; null when the cycle has no new frame (not a repeat of the last one).
t_image.title: T Image

cmd_upper.description: Commanded joint angles, rad: action[0:28], in the order of UPPER_BODY.
cmd_upper.title: Cmd Upper

meas_upper.description: Measured joint angles, rad, in the order of UPPER_BODY.
meas_upper.title: Meas Upper

cmd_lower.description: action[28:34] + action[35]: waist roll, pitch, yaw (rad), base_height (m), vx, vy (m/s, heading frame of the base), target_yaw (rad, world).
cmd_lower.title: Cmd Lower

meas_lower.description: Measured, same order: waist joint angles, base height, base velocity in the heading frame, base yaw in the world frame.
meas_lower.title: Meas Lower

title: TraceStep
